feature: Paste question, marking scheme and typed answers, or load the sample class
Marker: per-criterion marks, each with the line from the answer that earned it
Hard checks in code (quote is in the answer, marks add up) and Break it: a bad quote is rejected on screen
Match my marking: teacher marks 6, the tool tunes the scheme until it matches her (up to 3 rounds), teacher approves the scheme
Review and approve: teacher edits any mark and approves the class
Proof panel: agreement with the teacher on unseen answers, before and after tuning, beside the human-human baseline; misses listed
Replay of a recorded real run, labelled as recorded
Doubt queue: every answer marked twice, disagreements first, with a same-mark-twice count
Class mistake map: the criteria most students missed, with counts and quotes
Strictness dial: the class total under strict, standard and lenient readings
Objective answers marked by exact match in code
Handwritten photo to typed answer, teacher confirms the transcript
Batch: a whole paper of several questions for a full class
Voice feedback in Telugu or Hindi
